next_step: Package only this frozen model for a shadow-mode browser pilot; log decisions without blocking users.
Measure latency and manually review false alerts and missed phish before choosing any production action threshold.
not_supported: Production-ready status: latency, memory, privacy, browser integration, monitoring, and live alert adjudication remain untested.
Universal phishing coverage: two phishing feeds and a Tranco legitimate proxy cannot represent the whole web.
supported: The selected model transfers to a new identity-disjoint cohort at 5.00% phishing prevalence.
The result used no retraining, threshold tuning, checkpoint selection, or comparison against the other 105 models.

comparison_interpretation: On the final cohort, recall changed from 87.05% to 89.90% and FPR from 0.96% to 1.19%. Precision changed from 97.49% to 79.91%; much of that movement is expected when phishing prevalence changes from 30.07% to 5.00%.
methodological_status: one-shot 5% phishing prevalence sensitivity test; never training, calibration, threshold selection, or model selection; model, checkpoints, ensemble, calibration, and threshold frozen before inference
source_limitations: Tranco rank membership is a legitimate-domain proxy, not manual page-level adjudication.
Root-domain legitimate URLs underrepresent deep legitimate paths, parameters, and redirects.
The 5.00% prevalence is a declared deployment simulation, not a measurement of one person's browsing history.
PhishTank and the limited OpenPhish feed do not cover every campaign, language, or region.
Source families have appeared in earlier project work, although every URL, hostname, and encoded identity here is unseen.
threshold_policy: three-seed mean score; maximum calibration F1 subject to calibration FPR <= 1.00%

verdict.heading: OFFLINE CANDIDATE CONFIRMED
verdict.text: The locked model retained at least 80% phishing recall with no more than 2% false-positive rate on a completely identity-disjoint, low-prevalence cohort.
